title: Spaz
body:
not all symphonies are beautiful.
and yours.
is among the worst i've ever witnessed.

every time i take a seat in the audience
it's like a car crashed
through the green room jacked up on nitro
and frantically conducted a middle school
orchestra with its out of sync windshield wipers and for some reason.
i signed up to chain myself to the seat like odysseus with the sirens but

this isn't some epic adventure humanity will glaze infinitely for the rest of time.
